wonder.title: Sound start, one ordering question
wonder.body: I agree with starting on module power and relay control. Both match the code and symptom, are marked quick, can clear their cause on a pass, and help avoid costly parts. I question putting the module in-versus-out compare ahead of the pin inspection. The compare clears nothing on a pass and is listed as taking longer, while the pin check can clear damaged pins. The donor index check last fits its low code and symptom match, but it must still be done before fitting.
wonder.watch: Recorded results would change my view. Good power and a relay click would clear those causes and raise the value of the pin and module checks. A power fail would point toward wiring as listed, and damaged pins found early would make the module compare less needed. A donor index mismatch would stop that path regardless of order.
